changes.before: Work the registers record as yours, grouped by the question you are asking: what is assigned to me, what is due today, what is past due, and what is blocked. Every group names the register it was read from, the reason the record is waiting, the next action and the role that owns it. Opening a record changes nothing — the server still decides whether you may act.
changes.after: View assigned, due, overdue and blocked work. Each group shows its source, next step and responsible role. Opening a record does not change it or grant permission to act.
changes.meaningReview: Controlled terms, permissions, state transitions and data remain unchanged; presentation copy only.

changes.before: A record can belong to more than one group — one task can be both assigned to you and past its due date — so a group count is that group's own question, not a share of a total. Each record is listed once, under its most urgent group.
